story_generator.name: Story Generator
story_generator.notes: AI Recommend: every style word the AI wrote (Genre / Mood / Energy / Vocal that are not one of the choices) is added to the caption that is used, and the cards no longer show the 'not applied' warnings for them; Genre and Mood take the first of the AI's words that is a choice. 0.3.3: syllable-level rhyme map (rmap-2), live / dead syllable view; needs pythainlp 5.4.0 or newer.
